definitions.gloss: seismic isolation; earthquake isolation; base isolation
definitions.explanation: A structural engineering technique that isolates a building from ground motion during an earthquake, reducing the shaking transmitted to the structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{免震|めんしん}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧だ。
{免震|めんしん}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減|へ}らした→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
examples.english: The seismic isolation system greatly reduced the earthquake shaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{免震|めんしん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れられている→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many recent high-rise apartment buildings incorporate seismic isolation technology.

notes:
Compound of {免|めん} (exempt, avoid) + {震|しん} (tremor, earthquake). Japan is a world leader in seismic isolation technology due to its high earthquake risk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {免震|めんしん}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧: seismic isolation structure
- {免震|めんしん}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧: seismic isolation device
- {免震|めんしん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: seismic isolation technology
- {免震|めんしん}⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧: seismic isolation rubber bearing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耐震|たいしん}→耐震：06222_taishin⟧: earthquake-resistant — makes the building strong enough to withstand shaking, rather than isolating it from the shaking
- ⟦{制震|せいしん}→制震：29390_seishin⟧: vibration control/damping — uses devices to absorb and reduce vibrations within the structure

USAGE:
In real estate listings, {免震|めんしん} is considered a premium feature and often highlighted as a selling point for apartments and condominiums.
